requirements.text: At least five years managing complex, multi-partner programs, ideally grant-funded research, policy or public-interest programs in Europe.
Proven track record managing funders or institutional partners, including donor reporting, budgets and grant compliance.
Experience coordinating consortia or networks of external partners, including contracts, scopes of work and partner payments.
At least four years leading teams and working cross-functionally, including with senior experts you do not line manage.
Strong budget and financial management skills, with ownership of program cost sheets and forecasts.
High digital collaboration literacy (Slack, Monday.com, Notion, G-Suite or similar) and comfort running remote work across many countries.
Strong attention to detail and organisational skills, with excellent communication.
Experience with EU-funded or foundation-funded research programs (for example Horizon Europe, Erasmus+ or major philanthropic grants).
Familiarity with research operations: publication cycles, data protection (GDPR), research ethics and data-sharing agreements.
Interest in AI, the labour market, skills or the future of work; familiarity with EU institutions such as Cedefop, Eurostat, Eurofound or the JRC.
A second EU language, especially German, French, Spanish, Italian or Polish.
A recognised project management certification (for example PMP or PRINCE2).
Experience managing sub-grants or sub-recipients, including selection processes and flow-down compliance.

resumes.text:
Elena Varga
Senior Programme Manager, Vienna, Austria

Summary
Programme manager with seven years of experience running multi-partner, grant-funded research and public-interest programmes across Europe. Strong track record of managing funder relationships, donor reporting and clean grant audits, with on-time delivery throughout.

Experience
Senior Programme Manager, Northwind Civic Labs, Vienna (March 2020 to present)
- Manage a three-year, EUR 4.2 million grant-funded research programme on urban mobility covering 14 countries.
- Built and own the implementation plan, deliverables calendar and risk register agreed with the funder.
- Released milestone payments to eleven partner organisations against signed work terms.
- Led cross-functional teams for six years, including senior specialists I did not manage directly.
- Own the programme cost sheet and quarterly forecasts; secured approval for three budget reallocations.
- Ran a team spread across nine countries using weekly stand-ups and shared project boards.
- Delivered three years of funder reporting with zero late submissions and few revisions from reviewers.
- Put in place consent checks and written terms governing who may view survey respondents' records across borders.
- Managed sub-grant calls and recipient payment schedules for the programme's regional partners.

Programme Coordinator, Harbour Foundation, Hamburg (2017 to 2020)
- Coordinated a foundation-funded network of six research institutions working on digital health.
- Worked on a Horizon Europe project as deputy coordinator, tracking partner deliverables against contracts.
- Supported a 2024 labour market study using Eurostat data on automation and skills.

Education
MA in Public Policy, Central European University, 2016
BA in Political Science, University of Vienna, 2014

Skills
Programme management, donor and funder reporting, budget forecasting, grant compliance, partner contracting, stakeholder communication, remote team leadership.

Languages
English: fluent, written and spoken

Japanese: conversational
